name: Brian King
bio: Brian King is a Tech Lead at Raizlabs where he gets to make awesome apps and support coworkers doing the same. In-between projects he likes to work on tools like the Swift compiler and Eject as well as libraries like RZBluetooth and BonMot. When not in front of a computer he tries to get his dog to take care of his son so he can spend some time with his wife. It has yet to work.
